EXPLICIT PAIRED REGULAR EXPRESSION: type ['B', 5, 0] order [0, 2, 4, 1, 3]
Alphabet: 0=Delta^-1; 1=Delta; a<b<c<... in the stated generator order.
A pair [u=>v] denotes the single binomial u-v; empty word is "".
Union +, coordinatewise concatenation ., and coupled Kleene star * act on sets of pairs.
Use the SAME path/choice in both coordinates. The basis is generally NOT reduced.
Definitions below are acyclic; all RHS node references have smaller indices.
